test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian mission focuses on generating clean energy from hydrogen fuel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Green Hydrogen Mission**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• The **National Green Hydrogen Mission** is the primary Indian initiative dedicated to making India a global hub for the production, usage, and export of **Green Hydrogen** and its derivatives.

• Launched by the Government of India in **January 2023**, the mission aims to develop a green hydrogen production capacity of at least **5 MMT (Million Metric Tonnes)** per annum by **2030**.

• The core objective is to reduce **carbon emissions**, decrease dependence on imported **fossil fuels**, and promote the use of **clean energy** in sectors like transport, industry, and power.

• **National Solar Mission** (launched in 2010) focuses on promoting solar power generation and is one of the eight missions under the **National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)**, but it is not specifically for hydrogen fuel.

• **National Wind Energy Mission** focuses on harnessing wind power, while **National Green Energy Project** is a general term often used for various renewable initiatives but is not a specific standalone mission like the Hydrogen Mission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Green Hydrogen** is produced through the **electrolysis** of water using electricity generated from **renewable energy** sources like solar or wind.

• The mission includes the **SIGHT** (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) program, which provides financial incentives for the domestic manufacturing of **electrolysers** and production of green hydrogen.

• The total initial outlay for the mission is approximately **19,744 crore rupees**.

• It is expected to attract over **8 lakh crore rupees** in total investments and create over **6 lakh jobs** by 2030.
